title: My Workout
author: Ricardo
desc: Transform your physique with "My Workout," a comprehensive 4-week program designed for intermediate lifters. Committing to just 4 days a week, you'll engage in targeted muscle sculpting routines that include essential barbell and dumbbell exercises like squats and incline bench presses. Each session lasts about 40 minutes, ensuring you maximize your time in the gym while building strength and definition. Equip yourself with a full gym and get ready to elevate your training to the next level!
